doc_summary: `native_living_damage_pre` observes server player damage after armor and magic and before absorption. A mod can replace `new_damage`. The container's remaining mutable state is not yet applied; mob paths are not yet wired. Bundles need `"hooks": @API:living_damage_pre@`.
